headline: Sensex rebounds 1,300 points from day's low to cross 25,700 while Bank Nifty hits record high

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian markets staged a strong intraday rebound, with Sensex jumping 1,300 points from its day's low.
Early morning trading saw pressure due to global weakness after Nasdaq fell 2.3% on an AI stock sell-off.
Bank Nifty crossed the 64,000 mark for the first time, helping lift overall benchmark indices.
Profit-taking and concerns over Fed rate hike signals initially pulled Nifty below 25,450 before buying returned.
whatHappening: Sensex recovered sharply to trade over 700 points higher while Nifty 50 pushed past 25,700.
Newly-listed companies contributed ₹32-trillion to BSE market capitalization in 2026.
Urban Company raised ₹2,500 crore through a QIP, attracting demand exceeding ₹15,000 crore.
Pristine Logistics & Infraprojects received SEBI approval to float its initial public offering.
summary: Indian benchmark indices opened lower amid global sell-offs in tech and AI stocks but rebounded sharply during intraday trade. Sensex erased early losses to jump over 700 points, taking Nifty 50 past 25,700. Bank Nifty touched an all-time high above 64,000 as buying momentum restored market sentiment.
